case.title: The Technician filter lists "Deleted technician" last, only where that column exists
case.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}, in a browser window at least 1024 px wide. For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • {Technician-B} is active at {Location-A} with the "Technician" role and Time Clock on. For example: ZZAUTOTEST SV11594 Eli.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has two Approved work orders: {Work-order-1}, whose lead technician was deleted in Settings > Staff, and {Work-order-2}, led by {Technician-B}. For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SV11594 Deleted Lead.
  • {Location-B} is a second location you can switch to, with no work order whose lead technician was deleted (its Tech View shows no "Deleted technician" group).
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "Tech View" shown, "Search" empty, no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".

Setup

  1. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff > New Staff Member: First Name and Last Name (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST SV11594" "Dana"), an Email, Role "Technician", at least one Department, Location = {Location-A}, Time Clock on > Save & Close. Call this person {Technician-A}. Do not let them log any time: a person with logged labor cannot be deleted.
  2. Top menu Customers > New Customer > Name (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST SV11594 Deleted Lead") > Save; on the customer page add a Contact, then an Asset (Year, Make, Model).
  3. Work Orders > Create Work Order for that customer and asset > Save; add any ready-made line, approve it, and set Lead Technician to {Technician-A}. This is {Work-order-1}. Create {Work-order-2} the same way with Lead Technician {Technician-B}.
  4. Settings > Staff: find {Technician-A}, click the pencil, click "Delete" and confirm.
  5. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All > Tech View with the customer name in Search shows {Work-order-1} under a group named "Deleted technician".
case.custom_steps:
1. Click "Technician" in the filter bar and scroll to the end of the list.
  2. Type "Deleted" in "Search technician".
  3. Tick "Deleted technician", then press Escape.
  4. Type the name of {Customer-A} in "Search".
  5. Click "Board View" in the display switcher.
  6. Click "Technician", click "Clear selection", press Escape, and clear "Search".
  7. Change to {Location-B} (your initials at the top right > Change Location), open "Work Orders" > "All" > "Tech View", click "Technician" and type "Deleted" in "Search technician".
case.custom_expected:
Expected results

The PRD rule this test checks, word for word (S1-R15): “Last comes “Deleted technician” (S3-R20e), with the same grey “Inactive” label, while that column exists (SV-11594, a fast follow).”

  • Step 1: the last option is "Deleted technician", with the grey "Inactive" label, after every deactivated technician.
  • Step 2: "Deleted technician" is offered, with the grey "Inactive" label.
  • Step 3: only the "Deleted technician" group shows; every other group, pinned ones included, is hidden.
  • Step 4: the "Deleted technician" group shows {Work-order-1}; {Work-order-2} is not shown.
  • Step 5: Board View shows only the "Deleted technician" column, holding {Work-order-1}.
  • Step 6: every technician group shows again.
  • Step 7: "Deleted technician" is not offered at {Location-B}, where that column does not exist.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 81 (27 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 28 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10043, story SV-10044 (Story 1, Switch between display options); ticket SV-11594 (raised from SV-11575)

  • S1-R15: “In Tech View and Board View the filter bar also offers a Technician filter, after Assigned to me. It is a multi-select listing Unassigned first, then everyone who gets a group or column at this location: the location’s technicians (S9-R4), and any lead technician who keeps a column while still leading work orders here (deactivated, S2-N2 and S3-N2; not enrolled here, S3-R20b; Time Clock turned off, S3-R20d). Active technicians come first, by first name then last name, then deactivated technicians, by first name then last name, each with the same grey “Inactive” label as their column. Last comes “Deleted technician” (S3-R20e), with the same grey “Inactive” label, while that column exists (SV-11594, a fast follow). Someone who no longer gets a group or column is not listed. Choosing one or more shows only those technicians’ groups or columns; every other group or column, pinned ones included, is hidden. It filters by lead technician only.”
  • S3-R20e: “Work orders whose lead technician was deleted in Settings → Staff (the name no longer exists) sit in one column on Board View and one group in Tech View labeled “Deleted technician”, with the inactive marker and no drag grip. Work orders can be dragged out of it; nothing can be dropped onto it. List shows “Unassigned” in the Lead Technician column for these work orders, as today.”

Last checked against build v26.43.2-539491f on 10/28/2026.
